title: Quantitative Multi-Modal Optical Coherence Photoacoustic Elastography
summary: We present a novel multi-modal optical coherence photoacoustic elastography framework, which combines two imaging modalities, optical coherence tomography and photoacoustic tomography, to enable complementary absorption-scattering measurements for the extraction of quantitative tissue features via quasi-static elastography.
